Building collapses in Pune and Delhi; rescue operations underway

Building collapses have occurred in both Pune and Delhi, resulting in trapped individuals and fatalities. In Pune, a garbage mound caused a building collapse at a waste processing unit, with rescue efforts complicated by toxic gases and unstable debris. In Delhi, a building collapse claimed three lives, with an FIR registered. Both incidents highlight ongoing rescue operations amidst challenging conditions.
